title: Important Update: SFT-2517 Reporting for Depository Transactions Notified
content:
# Important Update: SFT-2517 Reporting for Depository Transactions Notified

Ek important update hai. Directorate of Income Tax (Systems) ne depository transactions se related Statement of Financial Transactions (SFT-2517) ke format aur procedures ke liye naye guidelines announce kiye hain.

*   **Notification Reference:** Yeh guidelines Notification No. 1 of 2026 dated September 10, 2026, ke through notify kiye gaye hain.
*   **Purpose:** Is notification ka main aim Section 508(1) of the Income-tax Act, 2025, read with Rule 237 of the Income-tax Rules, 2026, ke तहत capital gains on transfer of listed securities and Mutual Funds ki accurate reporting ensure karna hai. Isse taxpayers ke Income Tax Returns (ITRs) ko pre-fill karne mein madad milegi.
*   **Who Needs to Report:** Sabhi Depositories ko yeh information furnish karni hogi.
*   **Reporting Frequency:** SFT-2517 half-yearly basis par submit karna hoga.
    *   **First Half (April to September):** 30th September ko end hone wale half-year ke liye statement 31st October tak submit karna hai.
    *   **Second Half (October to March):** 31st March ko end hone wale half-year ke liye statement 30th April tak submit karna hai.
*   **Submission Method:** Depositories ko prescribed data file SFTP server ke through submit karni hogi, along with a separate control statement signed by the Designated Director.
*   **Key Details:** Notification mein Annexures A se E tak detailed guidelines, data structure, aur validation rules diye gaye hain for preparation and submission of the SFT. Reporting entities ko account holders ko bhi reported information provide karni hogi for reconciliation with the Annual Information Statement (AIS) in Form 168.
